objective: Build a deterministic, offline engineering test harness with fixtures, mocks/simulators, deterministic clocks/IDs, replay hooks, failure injection and execution-uncertainty semantics, enforced by the required governance CI gate.
scope: Create deterministic UTC clock with explicit advance/set behavior
Create deterministic ID sequence for reproducible correlation/test identities
Create fixture loader for canonical JSON fixtures
Create ordered replay tape that rejects duplicate/non-monotonic sequence and non-monotonic event time
Create scripted provider simulator with zero external/network side effects
Model TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN as unresolved, not rejection/success
Block blind retry while provider outcome is unresolved
Provide reconciliation hook before unresolved execution can continue
Create positive and negative canonical fixtures
Run harness tests and replay evidence in required governance CI
Include P04-E harness inputs in deterministic foundation artifact
Reconcile Current State, Task Catalog and Linear

dependencies: P04-C required governance aggregate CI gate
tests: Deterministic clock returns exact reproducible time and controlled advance
